$comment: What our outbound requests reveal about us, per service: User-Agent, identifying headers or parameters, and credential TYPES. Never store a secret, token or e-mail address here: this repo is public. Name the identity instead (e.g. 'lodewijk-email'). Service ids match settings/mandated-services.json where one exists. Rule (Lodewijk, 2026-10-16): his e-mail goes out only with his yes; registration and keys are his task. Keep this file current whenever a script starts or stops sending something.
